Située à Montréal, Canada, notre équipe dédiée offre des programmes de découverte via des modèles commerciaux de recherche contractuelle et de partenariat stratégique.
Notre objectif est de devenir un leader de classe mondiale dans l'utilisation de la spectroscopie RMN et d'autres méthodes biophysiques pour l'identification de pistes destinées à la découverte de médicaments. Nous avons déjà mis en œuvre des méthodes générant des données de haute qualité, permettant à nos clients et partenaires de prendre des décisions judicieuses et opportunes dans leurs projets actuels de découverte de médicaments.
N’hésitez pas à contacter notre équipe de qualité afin que nous puissions démarrer un partenariat exemplaire !

Name: BioAlert Solutions
Description:
BioAlert Solutions est une entreprise biotechnologique innovante qui a développé le tout premier appareil de détection automatisée de légionelle. BioAlert Lp 15 est destiné à sécuriser les tours de refroidissement et les systèmes d’eau chaude.
BioAlert Lp 15 est un système de surveillance installé sur site, automatisé et connecté en ligne avec le système d’eau afin de mesurer la conformité, et ce, sans intervention humaine, ni formation spécialisée. L’équipement offre aux propriétaires de bâtiments industriels et commerciaux d’avoir le contrôle absolu sur la bactérie Legionella pneumophila.

Située à Sherbrooke (Québec, Canada), l’entreprise compte plusieurs clients prestigieux dans le secteur des pâtes et papiers, de la pétrochimie, de la métallurgie et du domaine de la transformation alimentaire, de même que des organisations gouvernementales, telles que le Gouvernement du Canada, Hydro Québec, la Société québécoise des infrastructures et l’Université de Sherbrooke.
_______________________
BioAlert Solutions is an innovative biotechnology company that has developed the first ever automated legionella detection device. BioAlert Lp 15 is designed to secure cooling towers and hot water systems.

BioAlert Lp 15 is an on-site, automated monitoring system connected in-line with the water system to measure compliance without human intervention or specialized training. The equipment offers industrial and commercial building owners absolute control over Legionella pneumophila bacteria.

Located in Sherbrooke (Quebec, Canada), the company has several prestigious clients in the pulp and paper, petrochemical, metallurgy and food processing sectors, as well as governmental organizations such as the Government of Canada, Hydro Quebec, the Société québécoise des infrastructures and the University of Sherbrooke.

BioAlert Solutions represents a multidisciplinary team combining experts in biotechnology and optical detection systems as well as specialists in sales and marketing.

Name: High Q Technologies
Description:
High Q Technologies is a fast-growing company that develops quantum-enabled scientific instruments for ultra-high sensitivity biophysical and chemical analysis. By applying modern microwave quantum optics techniques to electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy, High Q is on a mission to redefine the standard in protein structure determination, the future of drug discovery, and the development of novel therapeutics. 

Built upon over a decade of research and development, our patented technologies are derived from advances in experimental quantum computing, utilizing inventions created in collaboration with the University of Waterloo. High Q is backed by Quantum Valley Investments and Blackberry co-founders Mike Lazaridis and Doug Fregin. The company is headquartered in Waterloo, ON.

Name: My Normative
Description: My Normative is a female-focused health platform driving innovation in the health sciences through clinically validated data collection, data management, and analytical processes.

Name: Réseau Bio-Innovation
Description: Le CQVB (Centre québécois de valorisation des biotechnologies) a pour mission d'accroître les capacités d'innovation des PME et les transferts technologiques dans le secteur des bio-industries au Québec. Le CQVB est un Centre de liaison et de transfert (CLT)  financé par le Ministère du Développement économique, de l'Innovation et de l'Exportation du Québec.

Name: Myomar Molecular
Description: Myomar Molecular is developing a diagnostic tool to identify early stages of muscle atrophy. This technology will be used by physiotherapists and medical doctors to access therapy approaches, reduce hospitalization time, and analyze recovery progress.

Name: Apogee Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
Description: Apogee Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Apogee) is redefining women’s health through precision, mechanism‐driven therapeutics. We unite scientific rigor with entrepreneurial agility to target the debilitating symptoms that affect women worldwide, due to chronic pain, infertility, inflammation, and other life‐altering manifestations of complex diseases . With a focus on high‐unmet‐need conditions such as endometriosis and adenomyosis, Apogee is developing and acquiring next‐generation therapies and diagnostics. In parallel, we are advancing existing programs that modulate the endocannabinoid system (ECS) to unlock its therapeutic potential in women’s health. Headquartered in Greater Vancouver, British Columbia, Apogee operates a 5,000‐square‐foot research facility and wet laboratory staffed by a world‐class team committed to translating breakthrough science into life‐changing treatments.

Name: Cellulotech
Description:
Cellulose is the most abundant organic compound on earth. Completely renewable, we believe it has tremendous untapped potential for our economic future and our environment.

Cellulotech is a company focused on R&D with a patent portfolio. We develop new materials and industrial processes around chromatogeny, a green chemistry process discovered by our Chief Scientist Daniel Samain.

Chromatogeny can offer barriers to water, oil, grease, vapour and/or oxygen to cellulosic substrates while preserving all the recyclability, compostability and biodegradability properties. This opens a world of new sustainable and competitive materials to several industries such as packaging, healthcare, fashion or construction.

Name: DFMZ - Design Filtration Microzone Inc.
Description:
DFMZ provides custom cleanroom solutions and lab equipment including biological safety cabinets, laminar airflow hoods, robotic/automation enclosures, extraction hoods, wet benches and forensic equipment. DFMZ products are manufactured in Ottawa, Canada and sold worldwide.

DFMZ Inc. is solely owned by our parent company Canerector Inc., Canada. We are part of 60+ companies with over 3000 employees located in 70+ facilities throughout North America. 

DFMZ Inc. was founded in January 2015 as a result of the merger between Microzone Corporation (f. 1969) and Design Filtration Inc. (f. 2000). We offer 50 years of experience and knowledge in the particulate and contamination control industry.  We are dedicated to giving you exceptional products and services with a focus on quality, efficiency and superior customer service.   

Our equipment and cleanroom systems are designed to provide a high degree of product, personnel and/or environmental protection for all branches of industry, including pharmaceutical and industrial/commercial, as well as science and technology sectors.

Name: Cyclenium Pharma Inc.
Description:
Cyclenium Pharma is a growing pharmaceutical R&D company exploiting its next generation CMRTTM macrocyclic drug discovery technology to identify novel small molecule therapeutics for difficult disease targets in areas of unsatisfied medical need. Cyclenium is creating value through progression of internal programs in oncology, infectious diseases and inflammation/pain. In addition, Cyclenium is providing its extensive experience and exploring its CMRT-based QUESTTM screening library in risk-sharing partnerships with leading academic and research driven non-profit organizations as well as collaborations with innovative pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies world-wide seeking to modulate unique and difficult disease targets in diverse therapeutic areas. 

As part of a recent expansion of our R&D efforts, Cyclenium is seeking creative and talented scientists with advanced degrees in Medicinal/Organic or Analytical Chemistry. Please see the careers page on our web site for additional details, http://www.cyclenium.com/open-positions/.

Name: Nucliq Biologics
Description:
We uncover your gut microbiome.

The gut microbiome is referred to all the microbes such as bacteria, viruses and fungus present in your intestine, which act as other vital organ that play a crucial role in maintaining good health. Presence of different types of good bacteria will benefit the health of the individual. The imbalance in diversity of bacteria, leading to increase in unhealthy bacteria can cause diseased condition called dysbiosis, which can affect gut health and can lead to intestinal diseases such as intestinal bowel syndrome or inflammatory bowel disease. Moreover, there is a growing evidence that gut dysbiosis can also lead to weight gain and other disorders. Therefore, it is very important to balance the gut microbiome in order to stay healthy and happy.
Location: St John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada

Name: Boreal Genomics
Description:
At Boreal, we are committed to improving cancer patient care through development of research tools and diagnostic tests based on monitoring of circulating tumor DNA in plasma.

Boreal’s OnTargetTM platform performs highly sensitive mutation detection to enable accurate tumor profiling and real-time monitoring of tumor evolution from cell-free DNA in plasma. The OnTargetTM assay is available as a research-use service to reveal tumor mutations that are undetectable with other methods and may help guide selection of therapy, improve clinical trial efficiency, and accelerate drug development programs.

Name: MEDNOVA DIAGNOSTICS INC.
Description: Mednova Diagnostics.ai is a biotech AI startup focusing on advancing health diagnostics through innovative saliva-based oral microbiome analysis, with the advancement of AI for pre-diagnosis. Our main goal is to develop and provide accessible, noninvasive diagnostic solutions for the early detection of diseases, cancers, and genetic disorders.

Name: BugSeq
Description: We're empowering microbiology labs to prevent and treat infections with DNA sequencing.

Name: Vesalius Cardiovascular Inc.
Description:
Vesalius Cardiovascular is a Canadian medical device company founded in 2016 in Vancouver, Canada. The company specializes in designing and developing biomedical devices for the treatment of cardiovascular disease, specifically mitral valve regurgitation (MR). We are clinical.

Our devices is introduced percutaneously (transfemoral/transseptal) to the heart, eliminating the need for open heart surgery and the related risks. The procedure can be performed by a Cardiovascular Interventionalist (Cardiologist or Cardiac Surgeon).  

Vesalius Cardiovascular is the result of several years of intensive private research and investigation, and advanced biomedical engineering. The inventor behind Vesalius Cardiovascular is Dr. Peter Skarsgard, a Vancouver-based Cardiac Surgeon, and Head of the Division of Cardiovascular Surgery at Vancouver General Hospital. 

Vesalius Cardiovascular has developed a biomedical device that can be introduced percutaneously (transfemoral/transseptal) to the heart, for the treatment of Degenerative MR (DMR).

The principles of surgical mitral valve repair are utilized, but sternotomy, heart-lung bypass, and cardiac arrest - components of an open heart operation - are not required.

Name: Genome Prairie
Description: Genome Prairie is a not-for-profit corporation leading large-scale bioscience research projects in Manitoba and Saskatchewan.  With national and international partners, Genome Prairie has supported nearly $260 million of research activity in plant, animal and human genomics, bioinformatics, instrumentation development and bioethics since 2000.  Learn more at: www.genomeprairie.ca.

Name: Clinicology - an FGK Company
Description:
Clinicology is the UK subsidiary of FGK Clinical Research, a trusted full-service CRO, partnering with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to transform innovative concepts into successful clinical outcomes. We blend scientific expertise, operational excellence, and a flexible, client-focused approach to deliver efficient, compliant, and tailored clinical trials. Our dedicated team supports studies across all phases and therapeutic areas, helping clients navigate complex regulatory landscapes and accelerate time to market.

Our Services:
•	Full clinical trial management (Phase I–IV)
•	Regulatory and ethics submissions
•	Project management and site monitoring
•	Provision of freelance clinical research personnel from our established network over many years
•	Data management and biostatistics
•	Pharmacovigilance and safety reporting
•	Medical writing and scientific documentation
•	Quality assurance and audit support

Therapeutic Areas:
•	Oncology
•	Cardiology
•	Neurology and psychiatry
•	Endocrinology and metabolic disorders
•	Rare and orphan diseases
•	Infectious diseases
•	Cell therapy/ATMPs
•	Medical devices and diagnostics

With FGK, clients gain a proactive, agile partner committed to delivering high-quality data, regulatory compliance, and measurable results that drive successful product development.

Name: Ostia Sciences Inc.
Description: Welcome to Ostia Sciences, a premier microbiome solutions company that specializes in discovering novel bacterial metabolites with antibacterial, antibiofilm, and immunomodulation activities. Our goal is to isolate beneficial microbes from the human oral microbiome, human breast milk, and fermented food, which are known to be rich sources of ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (RiPPs) and natural products with a range of biological activities.

Name: Copoly.ai
Description: At Copoly, we are revolutionizing early cancer detection with cutting-edge AI-driven diagnostics. Our flagship product, OncoSage, is a blood-based platform designed to detect cancer with exceptional accuracy using RNA sequencing and proprietary machine learning algorithms.

Name: Allumiqs
Description: Allumiqs is a strategic, outsourced CRO partner delivering multiomics, mass spectrometry, and data-driven solutions to help our biopharma and life sciences customers accelerate scientific discoveries and get to market faster.

Name: 3R Biotech
Description:
We are a leading provider of tissue culture technology, plant remediation, and HLVd pathogen testing solutions for the global hemp and agriculture industries. Through proprietary processes, advanced lab management software, and expert consultation, 3R helps cultivators propagate disease-free, high-value plants with consistent quality while safeguarding their elite genetics.

Almost every clonally-produced crop has moved to tissue culture plant starts for a reason. Plants that are starting disease-free tend to be highly vigorous throughout their life cycle and focus more energy on growth and secondary metabolite production, augmenting the performance of the crop and economic return.

We work with established breeders in every region to ensure that your genetics will help you succeed where you grow.

Name: BioNeutra North America, Inc.
Description:
BioNeutra North America (TSX: BGA.V) is a supplier of high quality prebiotic, dietary-fiber and low-caloric sweetener products, including VitaFiberTMIMO (www.VitaFiberIMO.com).

Founded in 2003, BioNeutra is seeking to become the premier North American supplier of high quality prebiotic and fiber ingredients and products. We are dedicated to addressing the needs of our customers and consumers in both mainstream and functional food markets.

Our product line provides ingredients for various food systems, contributing to advanced human nutrition and wellness in functional and healthy foods.

Our goal is to move science-based processes into the commercial product marketplace. From our head office and manufacturing base in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, BioNeutra focuses on providing consistent, quality ingredients for formulators and manufacturers.

With patented processes and product knowledge, we are able to leverage the manufacturing technology platform to discover, develop, manufacture, and market novel functional ingredients for food processors and food product formulators.

The key product benefits include dietary fiber, prebiotic function, and low caloric nutritive sweetener.

Name: Lexaria Bioscience
Description: DehydraTECHTM is Lexaria's patented drug delivery formulation and processing platform technology which improves the way active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) enter the bloodstream through oral delivery. Since 2016, Lexaria has developed and investigated DehydraTECH with a variety of beneficial molecules in oral and topical formats. DehydraTECH has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to increase bio-absorption and has also evidenced an ability to deliver some drugs more effectively across the blood brain barrier, which Lexaria believes to be of particular importance for centrally active compounds. Lexaria operates a licensed in-house research laboratory and holds a robust intellectual property portfolio and many patents pending worldwide.  For more information, please visit www.lexariabioscience.com.

Name: Mightex
Description:
Mightex develops cutting-edge all-optical cellular-resolution stimulation and imaging tools designed with life scientists in mind. From signaling networks inside cells to large-scale neural circuits in the brain, our solutions enable scientists to investigate life’s unanswered questions and push the boundaries of life science research.  

Our innovative solutions include our market-leading Polygon DMD illuminators for cellular-resolution photostimulation, the revolutionary OASIS Implant for in vivo Calcium imaging and optogenetics in freely behaving animals, as well as our diverse lineup of LED solutions. 

We look forward to supporting you and seeing your exciting scientific discoveries unfold!

Name: Membio Inc.
Description: Membio developed proprietary single-use bioreactor technology purpose built to enable the cost-effective and scalable manufacturing of cells. In late 2023, Membio's bioreactor technology was acquired by ABEC Inc.

Name: Rakovina Therapeutics
Description: Rakovina Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical research company focused on the development of innovative cancer treatments. Our work is based on unique technologies for targeting the DNA-damage response (DDR) powered by advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) platforms. By using AI, we can review and optimize drug candidates at a much greater pace than ever before.

Name: Zucara Therapeutics Inc.
Description: Zucara Therapeutics is developing ZT-01, a first-in-class, once-daily therapeutic to prevent hypoglycemia in people with T1D and insulin-dependent Type 2 diabetes. ZT-01 is designed to inhibit somatostatin, a pancreatic hormone that impairs the glucagon response to hypoglycemia in people with these conditions. ZT-01 is designed to restore glucagon secretion to prevent hypoglycemia, which could dramatically change diabetes disease management and improve both patient health and quality of life. For more information, visit www.zucara.ca.

Name: MicroSintesis Inc.
Description:
MicroSintesis wants to change the way the world fights diseases. 

Our vision is a world having more creative and effective options to fight diseases and their consequences. To do so, we need to look elsewhere. There is a growing body of evidence that supports micro-organisms having the ability to communicate with one another. Quorum sensing is the source of microbiome's balance and helps avoid dysbiosis leading to diseases or infections. 

MicroSintesis wants to revolutionize human and animal welfare through harnessing microbiome's full potential. 
 
Amongst immediate challenges, we find antibiotic resistance. This  has become an increasing threat to life. While the emergence of new resistant pathogens is accelerating, the ones already there are strengthening. Medical professionalss want to reduce the use of antibiotics, but evidently will not settle for less effectiveness. MicroSintesis is not just another probiotic company. We go a step ahead, strive for discovery and strongly believe that providing health practitioners with a response to antimicrobial resistance should find its way through science. 

Our solutions leverage years of worldwide scientific discoveries. We believe that our unique patented metabolite is at the heart of microbiome's communication system.

MicroSintesis  pioneers the creation of a new generation of science-based microbiome and health technologies. We are committed to lead microbiome's research, discover proven & effective alternative to antibiotics, impact long standing health challenges, improve human and animal welfare and promote access to new and effective health solutions.

Name: AdvancedAg
Description:
AdvancedAg is a Canadian biotechnology company dedicated to transforming the way farmers grow, manage, and protect their crops. Grounded in science, research, and real-world agronomy, we develop proven biological solutions that help farmers improve efficiency, strengthen soil health, and reduce their reliance on traditional chemical inputs.

From our roots in the Prairies to farms across the country, AdvancedAg now supports growers managing over half a million acres throughout Canada. Our rapid growth is driven by one clear belief: when biologicals are researched properly, applied correctly, and supported with education and transparency, they can deliver both profitability and sustainability at scale.

Our team works hand-in-hand with farmers, researchers, agronomists, and industry partners to push the boundaries of biologicals. Each product we launch is backed by multi-year research, on-farm validation, and a commitment to transparent, data-driven results.

Beyond product innovation, AdvancedAg is deeply invested in education and industry development, helping farmers understand how biologicals fit into full input programs, offering training for agronomists, and building tools that empower better agronomic decisions today and into the future.

As we continue to expand across Canada and into international markets, our mission remains the same:
to help farmers build healthier soil, grow more profitable crops, and move the agriculture industry forward through trusted, science-backed biologicals.

Name: DMark Biosciences
Description: D-MARK Biosciences is a Genomics focused Biotechnology company, supporting the most advanced genomic products available on the market today. Our products span the entire Next Generation Sequencing workflow from sample collection, through to library prep, and then onto analysis, LIMS, and data storage.  D-MARK Biosciences has carefully selected the most advanced technologies from around the world, and made them available to our customers in the USA and Canada. Each supplier offers a unique value to the genomics scientist that would offer better results in less time, at lower overall costs. Our customers include Genome Centers, High Throughput genomics labs, molecular diagnostics labs, and pharmaceutical research facilities from across North America.

Name: GenoTech.in
Description:
We deals with Custom made antibodies (monoclonal/Polyclonal), Readily available antibodies, Recombinant Protein Development, Gene Synthesis,Cloning, Peptide synthesis, Stable cell line development, IHC services, etc.
Apart from that we deal with few lab instruments, plastic wares, Lab consumables, Lab chemicals, Soya lecithin, soya hydrolysed lecithin, guar gum, natural vegetable and fruit powders, pectin etc.

Name: Launch Bioindustries
Description: Launch Bioindustries is developing sustainable biomaterials through advanced fermentation. We focus on creating high-performance, eco-friendly alternatives to traditional materials, reducing environmental impact and supporting a circular economy. Driven by science and sustainability, Launch Bioindustries partners with industries to pave the way for a greener future.

Name: ImmunoBiochem
Description: ImmunoBiochem is a pharma-partnered biotech developing novel degrader-antibody conjugate (DAC) therapeutics for precision immunology. DACs access unique mechanisms via targets on both the surface and inside cells, not accessible to other modalities, with a multi-modal layered logic-gated control of selectivity and potency for precise regulation of immunobiology. ImmunoBiochem's synthetic payloads designed with controlled targeted protein degradation (TPD) catalytic activity enable unparalleled in vivo programming of biology.

Name: Biofect Innovations
Description: Biofect Innovations is committed to sustainably transforming the food system by introducing high-value, market-driven ingredients essential for smart and eco-conscious food products. Leveraging the synergy of synthetic biology and fermentation technology, we develop unique microbes that produce ingredients, both structurally and functionally similar to those found in nature. This innovative approach not only supports the development of healthy and delicious food products but also champions environmental stewardship for future generations.

Name: Biotechnology and Bioengineering Conference
Description: Due to technology’s role in shaping the future of healthcare and medicine, the Biotechnology and Bioengineering Conference (BioTEC) aims to showcase cutting-edge developments and opportunities in the biomedical field. Through talks, demos, and discussions, BioTEC allows attendees to engage with world class researchers and professionals with past speakers from AstraZeneca, Harvard, MIT, Novartis, PointClickCare, and so much more. For the 8th annual conference, BioTEC 2025 will expose 200 exceptional delegates to topics including biotech beyond healthcare, personalized and regenerative medicine and women in biotech.

Name: SyntBioLab Inc.
Description:
SyntBioLab Inc is biotechnology company based in Quebec that develops alternative antimicrobials against pathogenic bacteria affecting feedstock. We do believe that the era of using preventive antibiotics in feed is over and efficient alternatives are needed to prevent emergence of antibiotic resistant superbug. 

SyntBioLab uses bacteriophages to fight bacteria infecting livestock. The bacteriophages are a natural and efficient alternative to antibiotics to prevent infection and they are safe for human. SyntBioLab’s mission is to promote animal health and public safety by avoiding antibiotic resistance. 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SyntBioLab Inc est une compagnie en biotechnologie basée à Québec qui développe des alternatives aux antibiotiques contre les bactéries qui affectent le bétail. Nous croyons que l'époque de l'utilisation des antibiotiques comme facteur de croissance dans les élevages est révolue et que des solutions alternatives doivent être développées afin d'éviter l'émergence de super bactéries résistantes aux antibiotiques. 

SyntBioLab utilise les bactériophages pour lutter contre les bactéries qui affectent les animaux d'élevage. Les bactériophages sont une alternative naturelle et efficace pour prévenir les maladies et ils sont très sécuritaires pour les humains. En utilisant les bactériophages comme alternative aux antibiotiques, SyntBioLab promeut la santé animale tout en évitant la résistance aux antibiotiques.

Name: Canary Cure Therapeutics
Description: Our novel RNA therapeutics target the endocannabinoid and energy expenditure systems, promoting the browning of white fat to increase metabolism and facilitate sustainable weight loss. Unlike conventional approaches, our therapies prioritize the preservation of lean body mass and offer the convenience of less frequent dosing, making them a promising solution for individuals battling difficult-to-treat obesity and its associated metabolic complications.

Name: Novoheart
Description:
Novoheart, a subsidiary wholly-owned by Medera (www.linkedin.com/company/medera-biopharmaceutical), is responsible for Disease Modelling & Drug Discovery using our proprietary award-winning mini-Heart Technology, which offers a range of bioengineered human heart constructs including the world’s first human heart-in-a-jar as healthy and diseased human hearts for testing toxicity and efficacy. 

This platform enables us to uniquely model human-specific diseases and discover therapeutic candidates all in the context of human cells and tissues, free from species-specific differences. 

Before privatisation by Medera, Novoheart was dually listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and Frankfurt Stock Exchange.

Name: Aurora Scientific
Description:
For over thirty years Aurora Scientific measurement instrumentation has been the choice of leading science researchers around the world. Our selection of dual mode lever systems and force transducers are used in a broad array of life science research specialties including exercise and metabolism, cardiology, injury recovery, gerontology, disease progression and pharmacology, and more. Our fast response sensors are considered benchmark instruments in olfaction research studying odor dynamics and pheromone/plume dispersion, and our mechanical stimulator technology is used in studies of the neuronal response to touch, pain and stretch. Many instruments have also been adapted for use by material science researchers studying the properties of artificial muscle, locomotion and nanomaterials. Legacy instruments used in the field of environmental monitoring and mine operations are still in use today.

Aurora Scientific is committed to creating products that answer questions and solve problems. We value excellence, innovation, responsiveness and the satisfaction of a job well done. And we share the researcher’s desire to broaden the boundaries of knowledge and understanding.

Name: Myzel Organics
Description:
Myzel offers full-spectrum, nutraceutical grade mushroom powders. 

Our mission is to produce the most sustainably-driven functional mushroom powders available on the market. We grow our mushrooms using renewable energy and specialize in fulfilling demand in the following segments:
- Functional Foods & Beverages
- Dietary Supplements
- Pet Care
- Livestock Nutrition
- Nutraceutical Products
- Superfood Supplements
- Cosmetics
- Consumer Packaged Goods

Name: CereCura Nanotherapeutics
Description: CereCura Nanotherapeutics is a preclinical stage biotechnology company developing novel RNA therapeutics for central nervous system disorders

Name: AspireBio Consulting
Description: AspireBio Consulting has a proven track record in helping move products from early development to commercial. Deep expertise in pre-clinical/non-clinical, CMC, quality, regulatory and FDA, Health Canada and EMA compliance for manufacturing and product release.

Name: SeraGene Therapeutics
Description:
SeraGene Therapeutics is a privately held biotechnology company based in Vancouver, Canada that specializes in the development of long-lasting RNA-based therapies for treating blood coagulation disorders (bleeding, thrombosis, and inflammation).

With extensive expertise in nanomedicine and clotting biology, we hope to one day realize a future where patients with coagulation disorders no longer live in fear of their next bleed or clot

Name: PurMinds NeuroPharma
Description: PurMinds NeuroPharma is pursuing breakthrough solutions for devastating neurological disorders with a special emphasis on neurodegenerative diseases.

Name: eNUVIO - Microfabricated Devices for Next-generation Cell Culture
Description:
Imagine a world where your experiments are cutting-edge, yet straightforward to perform, analyze and interpret, experiments that are time-saving, more accurate and more physiologically relevant. All this so you can get results sooner and move closer to your goal. This world is our vision!

We’re committed to developing next-generation technologies for you. Powered by scientists, we design and produce innovative microfabricated devices with feature-sized components that match the dimensions of biological cells, so that you can take full advantage of emerging cell culture technologies, such as stem cells & 3D culture systems. These easy-to-use and time-saving tools let you perform experiments that are more precise and physiologically relevant. They are also designed to increase experimental data output, reduce waste and minimize the requirement for lengthy training processes!

We currently offer easy-to use & ready-to-go culture devices for:

NEURONAL CO-CULTURE AND COMPARTMENTALIZATION
   Various configurations and formats available
AXON GUIDANCE AND CHEMOTAXIS
NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTIONS
   Motoneuron - 3D muscle co-culture devices
3D MUSCLE CULTURES
3D CULTURES
   Embryoid bodies and spheroids formation and processing

Many devices are available in two formats: 
2 experiments per device or fully HTS-compatible microplates (lowest cost per experiment)

Need something more specific? Contact us to learn more about our custom microfabrication services!

Name: stoked bio
Description: Stoked Bio leverages high-throughput biology and a diverse suite of state-of-the-art AI approaches to discover and design novel drugs to address urgent unmet clinical needs. We focus on developing novel therapeutics against bacterial, fungal, and viral infections, as well as high-need oncology applications. Our goal is to increase the rate and decrease the cost of getting powerful new drugs to patients.

Name: PhyCo Technologies
Description:
PhyCoTM addresses the $7.1 trillion plastic crisis through proprietary seaweed biorefinery technology. We're developing compostable alternatives to petroleum-based agricultural plastics—the 70% of plastic use that occurs behind the scenes.

Our breakthrough approach combines Canadian seaweed cultivation with localized organic waste streams to create bio-based pellets, films, and coatings. Unlike traditional bioplastics, our process is designed for industrial-scale production.

Advancing from R&D to commercial scale with protected IP and strategic industry partnerships. Focused on serving the massive but overlooked B2B plastic market where real environmental impact happens.

We're actively seeking investors and stakeholders in the agritech space who can help us spread the word and spread our plastics across markets ready for sustainable transformation.

Name: Canurta Therapeutics
Description:
Canurta Therapeutics is a biotechnology company discovering and bioprocessing rare, multipotent polyphenols to find new ways to reverse the chronic disease crisis with botanical therapeutics. 

With our advanced technologies, Canurta can capture, purify, and enrich rare polyphenols for the first time to target inflammation and address unmet needs in neurology, virology and oncology.

Name: EVAH Corp.
Description:
EVAH Corp is a proud Canadian biotechnology company based in Quebec that is focused on developing animal health technologies. Our mission is to find better ways to feed the planet, address consumer needs for non-antibiotic protein, and increase the sustainability of food by fostering innovation.

With the global population forecasted to reach 9 billion by 2050, a 100% increase in food supply will be required to feed the planet. Without increased sustainability in food production, achieving net-zero emissions will be impossible, regardless of other measures taken. Additionally, the increased number of livestock and exposure of related diseases to humans creates a higher probability of future global pandemics. 

With more animals needed to feed the population, the risk of a disease transmissible to humans in addition to antibiotic resistance in humans increases. As antibiotic resistance is building, the risk of diseases decimating animal populations puts the global food supply at risk and poses a serious risk to humans.

Enhancing food animal health will be essential to protect the planet and human health. The One Health Approach concept demonstrates that the health of the animals used for food is directly tied to humanity’s future objectives. 

Increasing the economic efficiency of environmentally sustainable food will be imperative for Canada and the world to achieve net-zero targets.

EVAH’s platform develops the animal health technologies the planet needs. These will help build the resilience of the Canadian and global food supply chain and contribute to Canada’s climate change and human health goals.

Name: ViewsML
Description:
ViewsML is building the world's first virtual biomarker library using AI to generate per-cell spatial insights from routine pathology images without the need for physical immunohistochemistry (IHC). By virtualizing IHC, a diagnostic process that has remained unchanged for decades, ViewsML enables scientists and clinicians to generate biomarker staining results in minutes rather than the days to weeks required by conventional methods. 
The company’s platform analyzes standard H&E pathology slides to predict biomarker spatial expression at the individual cell level while preserving precious tissue samples and integrating into existing workflows. The result is faster biomarker discovery, accelerated clinical trials, and earlier insights that can guide treatment decisions for patients.
Working with leading pharmaceutical companies, diagnostic labs, and healthcare systems, ViewsML is helping unlock the full biological value of existing pathology data and enabling a faster, more scalable path to precision medicine.To learn more, visit www.viewsml.com.

Name: Apricell Biotechnology Inc.
Description: Apricell Biotechnology is an early-stage company with a focus on developing life science-based technologies interfacing with biomaterials, and tumor biology. Name: BioThera Solutions
Description:
Aging is the one experience none of us escape, and for many, it brings a quiet sense of powerlessness against our own bodies. BioThera exists to give people options where they felt they had none. We believe advanced biotechnology should let people meet aging on their own terms, repairing the body from within, rather than masking how it changes.

We work with one of the body's own tools: the extracellular vesicle (EV, or exosome), the natural system cells use to repair, signal, and regenerate. EVs hold extraordinary promise for human health and longevity, but that promise has been held back by a single problem: no one can make them reliably at scale. That's the problem BioThera solves.

We're building the scalable biomanufacturing platform for EVs, the production, characterization, and quality infrastructure that lets EV-based products be made consistently at clinical and commercial scale. We integrate isolation, characterization, formulation, and batch-level quality control under MISEV, the international consensus standard for EV research and manufacturing, so every product carries verified particle concentration, full MISEV-aligned characterization, and traceable documentation.

Our first product is Vesera, a clinically deployed, plant-derived EV skincare made for dermatology and medical-aesthetic clinics, that rejuvenates the skin like nothing else. Vesera is where our platform meets the world first; regenerative medicine, drug delivery, and beyond are where it's headed.

We start with skin. We're building for human longevity.

Headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.

Name: Department of Biomedical Engineering University of Alberta
Description:
The Department of Biomedical Engineering is located in the Research Transition Facility, which was originally built in three sections during the 1940's and 50's as a Nurses' Residence. The main office is located in room 1-098 (nearest the south entrance).

The Department was established in 1982, although its roots date back to 1967. We are interdisciplinary in outlook, interfacing closely with other departments in the:

Faculty of Medicine & Dentistry
Faculty of Engineering
Faculty of Science
Faculty of Rehabilitation Medicine
We also have links with Biomedical Engineering at the University of Calgary.

Our Department serves to facilitate the development and application of engineering and science to the study of medical problems.

The Department of Biomedical Engineering offers research opportunities and courses leading to MSc and PhD degrees. Our primary areas of research are biomaterials, magnetic resonance imaging, magnetic resonance spectroscopy and rehabilitation engineering. Students may elect to register for the MSc or PhD degrees in another department while carrying out research and being co-supervised within the Department of Biomedical Engineering. Those departments particularly suited for this option include the following:

Department of Chemical & Materials Engineering
Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering
Department of Mathematical & Statistical Sciences
Department of Mechanical Engineering
Department of Physical Therapy
Department of Physics
Department of Physiology
Department of Psychology
Persons seeking to be admitted as graduate students to the Department of Biomedical Engineering must, in addition to satisfying the admission requirements of the Faculty of Graduate Studies and Research, hold an earned degree in engineering or a physical science.

Sono Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a pioneer in Immuno-Sonodynamic Therapy (SDT), a unique technology platform involving a non-toxic family of ultrasound-sensitive, small molecular weight compounds. The dual technology attacks cancer on two fronts. Firstly, ultrasound activation of this compound can produce toxic radicals directly inside the tumor cells. Secondly, Immuno-SDT can potentially induce an anti-tumor response from the patient’s own immune system to identify and eliminate local and distant metastases. Tumor selectivity is achieved through the selective application of ultrasound.
Benefits: The two-pronged approach can potentially lead to long-term tumor control with minimal side-effects. Immuno-SDT is minimally invasive, as ultrasound can be administered externally. The non-activated drug is non-toxic, so it does not cause side-effects related to systemic toxicity as observed in standard chemotherapy. There are no cumulative dose limits as in chemo- and radiotherapy, allowing for re-treatment. Many other available ultrasound sensitive drugs lack activation potential and biocompa tibility. Importantly, the treatment has the ability to activate the patient’s own immune system to attack local and distant metastases in effort to achieve long term control.

- Receive tumor tissue or biopsy samples

Name: Precision
Description:
The most powerful therapeutic antibodies in existence have one problem. They work everywhere in the body at once, not just where you need them. The result is toxicity that caps the dose, limits the application, and leaves extraordinary medicine sitting unused.

Every approach so far has tried to engineer around this. We solved it differently.
Precision Immunotherapeutics is built around CAA, Cloaked Antibody Activation, a proprietary platform that renders any therapeutic antibody completely inert, delivers it safely at full dose, then activates it precisely where and when it's needed. Nowhere else.

The applications span oncology, infectious disease, inflammatory conditions, and beyond. The implications for antibodies currently sitting shelved, too powerful to use safely, are significant.

The science is published. The data already shows it works.

Now we're building the team to take it further.

Name: Mentis Care AI
Description:
Mentis Care is transforming neurological care from episodic visits to continuous monitoring and insight. Mentis is focused on improving outcomes in neurology, beginning with epilepsy.

Bringing together EEG, biosensor signals, wearable data, and longitudinal patient information, Mentis creates a continuous view of neurological health. The result is better insight for clinicians, greater confidence for patients and caregivers, and a foundation for more proactive care.

The Mentis platform supports continuous seizure monitoring and detection while advancing toward seizure prediction and more proactive neurological care. In parallel, Mentis is building longitudinal neurological datasets to advance research, real-world evidence, and future care models.

Through collaborations with Emory University and other leading institutions, Mentis is developing the AI foundation for the future of neurology—one designed to scale beyond epilepsy and across neurological disorders.

Our vision is a future where continuous insight enables earlier intervention, more personalized care, and better outcomes for people living with neurological disorders.

The SOULCAP Foundation aims to establish the globally accepted standard for identifying immune cell populations through cytometry, addressing a critical gap. SOULCAP brings together stakeholders from industry (including pharmaceutical companies, CROs, cytometry instrument and reagent manufacturers), ontology and software developers, scientists and clinicians. Our Advisory Board comprises leadership from key organizations such as ICCS, ISAC, IUIS, ESCCA, FOCIS, NIH, and NIST, ensuring broad acceptance and sustainability.

Using UVC technology, ULTRASAN uvc technology is able to sanitize mobile devices, IPads, Laptops, tools, face shields and other equipment in under 60 seconds.

Description:
SciMed Technologies is a Canadian based diagnostic product development company, primarily dedicated towards the research, development and commercialization of state of the art diagnostic and analytical products for the nutritional and clinical industries.
Our products are globally recognized as VitaKit ATM and VitaKit DTM. VitaKits are ELISA based diagnostic kits that rapidly and accurately measure vitamin A and vitamin D in liquid milk.  VitaKit ATM and VitaKit DTM have been developed and are sold by SciMed Technologies Inc.

Pipeline Products: SciMed is developing new microfluidic chips (Nutri-ChipTM) which will intergrate a number of laboratory diagnostic tests onto a single chip a few square centimetres in size.  Microfluidic lab-on-a-chips will be able to measure a number of nutritional ingredients and biological molecules important for food safety and human health. Nutri-ChipsTM are inserted into a robust hand-held detection meter that can read the analysis and results of the Nutri-ChipTM. The hand-held diagnostic can provide diagnostic results almost instantaneously at the Point-of-Need (PON). For a description of the technology please follow the link below.

Name: Sargastream
Description:
SargaSTREAM is an international, community-centered, and transdisciplinary research initiative tackling one of the fastest-growing environmental challenges in the Tropical Atlantic: the massive influxes of pelagic Sargassum seaweed. These floating mats, once largely confined to the Sargasso Sea, now wash ashore in record quantities, affecting coastal ecosystems, local economies, and public health.

Bringing together scientists, educators, local leaders, and policymakers from across the Caribbean, South America, North America, and Asia, SargaSTREAM combines cutting-edge research with practical, community-led solutions. The project focuses on four key areas:

Monitoring & Prediction – Using satellite imagery, drones, and local reporting to track sargassum movements and forecast landings.

Air Quality & Health – Studying and mitigating the release of gases from decomposing sargassum to protect community health.

Biodesign & Education – Equipping educators and local leaders with innovative, hands-on tools to teach about sargassum, sustainability, and climate change.

Blue Economy Viability – Researching and testing sustainable uses for sargassum to create local economic opportunities while protecting marine environments.

By merging rigorous science with local knowledge and creativity, SargaSTREAM empowers coastal communities to transform a pressing environmental threat into a catalyst for sustainability, resilience, and innovation

Name: Next Pharma Inc.
Description:
Next Pharma Inc. (NPI) is a biotechnology company focusing on developing and commercializing products for the early detection, diagnosis, treatment and monitoring the recurrence of cancer in addition to treat bacterial, fungal and viral infections including HCV infection.
Next Pharma’s novel products are: a blood test that can measure the blood level of Aspartyl (Asparaginyl) β-Hydroxylase (AABH) and two Peptide Based Drug candidates (cLF-671 and cLF-672) that should treat HCV and different types of Cancer. AABH (a novel cancer bio-marker), cLF-671 and cLF-672 (two novel Therapeutic engineered peptides) are the products which make  the foundation of our breakthrough technology.
Next Pharma, is closing its Series C financing for a total of $14 million (Lead Director Kiarash Moshiri) and will be in a strong position to complete the animal study of its lead anti-Cancer and anti-HCV Peptide Based Drugs, as well as pursuing its late-stage pre-clinical candidates toward integrated cancer management.  Next Pharma’s lead Peptide Based Anti-Cancer and Anti-HCVDrug candidates, and it’s late-stage pipeline of pre-clinical candidates, as well as it’s cancer diagnostic products, constitute Next Pharma’s integrated cancer management program.  Relaying on our hard working in-house senior scientists and our worlds class collaborators, we strongly believe that we will pursue this extraordinary program. Beyond our lead Peptide Based Drug candidates and AABH based Early diagnostic cancer tests, our early-stage next pipeline of products consists of Radio-immuno-imaging to determine the site and size of tumor. I this pipeline of products, we would use a radioisotope-labeled, all human, anti-AABH antibody and radio-immunotherapy using high-energy, short-lived alpha or beta emitting radioisotopes bound to the anti-AABH antibody to specifically target cancer cells.

Name: Ness Therapeutics

Ness Therapeutics aspires to transform the respiratory virus infection drug market from “treatment to cure” to “protection from infection” via prophylactic application for known and newly emerging viruses.

Our vision is to revolutionize the respiratory virus infection drug market, shifting the focus from mere treatment to proactive protection through prophylactic interventions for both known and newly emerging, unidentified viruses. We aim to disrupt conventional methods such as vaccines and pathogen-targeted therapeutics, drawing inspiration from our innate immune system. By establishing a virus-agnostic strategy, our goal is to block transmission from infected individuals, ushering in a new era of virus control.

Name: IAMLAB
Description:
The Image Analysis in Medicine Lab (IAMLAB) focuses on design, development and translation of AI tools for medical images. These innovative software tools can discover disease subgroups and describe pathology more accurately.  

A large focus is translation through algorithm commercialization, and uptake into clinical practices to improve turn-around-times, inter-rater agreement and accuracy of radiologists and pathologists; which improve quality of care. 

IAMLAB is led by Dr. April Khademi, Canada Research Chair in AI for Medical Imaging, who has 10+ years of academic & industrial experience in designing and commercializing AI tools for medical imaging.  She partners with clinicians and biomedical companies from Canada.

Name: Replicor Inc.
Description:
Replicor Inc. is a Canadian biotechnology company focused on the development of its nucleic acid polymer (NAP) technology for the treatment of hepatitis B (HBV) and delta (HDV) infections.

NAPs are the only antiviral agent to directly target the immunosuppressive protein (HBsAg) which drives chronic HBV infection and liver disease.  Our lead clinical NAP drug product is REP 2139-Mg, a proprietary formulation of REP 2139 which makes once weekly subcutaneous injections easily tolerated.

Replicor's latest clinical data demonstrates that NAP-based combination therapy can restore immune control of HBV infection in 78% of patients and eliminate HDV infection in 74% of patients.  These effects persist in the absence of any therapy, allowing the liver to heal.

REP 2139-Mg based combination promises to revolutionize the therapy of chronic HBV and HDV infection and play a pivotal role in the WHO's goal of eliminating viral hepatitis by 2030.

Name: Synucure Therapeutics
Description:
Synucure Therapeutics inc. is a Canadian biotechnology company conducting research in brain degenerative disorders. Synucure was founded in 2021 with the key objective to pursue the promising and robust pre-clinical work of Dr. Francesca Cicchetti on a repurposed drug called Cysteamine which demonstrated, in various animal and cell models, that the drug could prevent and/or reverse a number of features related to Parkinson’s Disease (PD). Her research on the potential benefits of Cysteamine in neurodegenerative disorders was initiated 20 years ago. 

In addition to the promising role of Cysteamine as a Disease Modifying Therapy (DMT) in Parkinson, Dr. Cicchetti and her colleagues conducted research on patented blood biomarkers, of which the main objective is to provide clinicians with a more precise diagnostic and stratification tool for the disease using a simple blood test.

If you need more information, please contact us at info@synucure.com

Name: MedBiome
Description: MedBiome is a biopharmaceutical company with a novel platform for the identification, screening and development of microbiome modulators. MedBiome harnesses its unique platform to advance the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), Alzheimer's Disease, and colorectal cancer  through patients stratification and the development of novel microbiome-targeted therapeutic and nutritional approaches.

Name: bowen's FX Therapeutics
Description:
Bowen's FX Therapeutics was founded by Jeff Parr following the diagnosis of his grandson, Bowen Parr with full mutation Fragile X Syndrome and Jeff’s desire to find a cure for Bowen and all who have Fragile X.

Our lead program is an engineered Fragile X Messenger Ribonucleoprotein (FMRP) replacement strategy in Lead Optimization, with an aim of selecting a clinical candidate in 2025.

Name: weCANdev Consulting Group Inc
Description: Advancing cell & gene therapy technologies through the deployment of expert product development teams focused on partner value creation from concept to market.

Name: The Hoare Lab
Description: The Hoare lab works at the interface of polymer engineering, physical chemistry, and biology, aiming to design novel materials with “smart” properties precisely tuned to the environment and application in which the material is to be used.  We have particular interest in the rational design of “smart” hydrogel-based materials on different length scales (i.e. bulk hydrogels, microgels, and nanogels).  We combine the synthetic tools of polymer chemistry, the analytical tools of physical chemistry, and the mathematical modelling tools of chemical engineering to create new hydrogels and other types of soft materials with chemistries, structures, and properties precisely engineered for applications in biomedical engineering (e.g. drug delivery, biosensors, and tissue engineering), agriculture/agrifood, and the environment.

Name: AstroYeast
Description:
Canadian finalists in the CSA/NASA Deep Space Food Challenge.

“Striving to create novel food technologies.
To carry humanity forward.
On Earth, the Moon, and beyond.”

Our food technology is centered around a yeast strain that is specially adapted to produce the nutrients crew members will need for their long voyage to our celestial neighbours, combined with flavour molecules that enhance the dining experience. The production of these nutrients and flavour molecules is performed in an automated and optimized bioreactor system. The end product is a delicious and nutritious yeast spread which can be safely consumed.

CubeSat Initiative for Canadians in STEM (CUBICS)
 
“Building a foundation in yeast research for space applications through microfluidic innovations” 

Scheduled to launch in 2025-2026, an AstroYeast payload will be tested in space conditions on board of Space Concordia's student-built SC-FREYR CubeSat.

Name: Advanced Agriscience
Description: Advanced Agriscience is a Canadian Public Benefit Company specialized in the development of biological crop inputs for climate resilience with an initial focus on frost, a leading cause of crop losses worldwide.

Name: Vital HumicTM
Description: Vital Humic utilizes rich organic ingredients, bio-fermentation, & nanotechnology to deliver products that provide real results. Our formulas can help you cut costs & optimize your current program.

Name: ImmuneChem Pharmaceuticals Inc.
Description:
ImmuneChem is a premier biotechnology company that focuses on the development and manufacturing of research related products in the areas of cell signaling and post-translational modification to facilitate advancements in scientific research. 

 

Since its inception in 1997, ImmuneChem has focused on developing a strong collaborative network and directly produces products as well as OEMs products to a range of customers all over the world.

Name: DiagnoChip Technologies
Description:
Welcome to DiagnoChip Technologies, where innovation meets precision in cancer diagnostics. We're a biomedical research company focused on revolutionizing early cancer detection.

Our Technology:
We specialize in nanomaterial-based CTC capture, leveraging nanofibers for their high surface area, biocompatibility, and customizable surfaces.

Precision Engineering:
Combining electrospinning and 3D printing, we fine-tune nanofiber structures for accurate CTC capture, setting a new standard in early cancer detection.

Biomarker Diversity:
Overcoming limitations of existing platforms, we use a non-covalent method to immobilize diverse cell biomarkers, expanding the range of detectable cancers.

Enhanced Purity and Recovery:
Our approach achieves higher purity and increased recovery of captured CTCs, surpassing conventional methods for more accurate analysis.

Our Commitment:
DiagnoChip Technologies is more than technology; it's a commitment to improving global healthcare. Join us in redefining cancer diagnostics with precision, innovation, and impact.

Name: Norton Scientific Inc
Description: Norton Scientific Inc (NSI) is no longer a functioning entity. The PAM Instrument design IP (all engineering drawings) and parts (at least 15 complete kits) are for sale. Ask for details: bcw50 (at) me.com.

Name: RNARevive
Description: At RNARevive, we harness the body's natural biology to create medicines. Instead of repeatedly delivering drugs, we enable the body to produce therapeutic proteins using biological processes trusted and optimized by millions of years of evolution.

Name: Biosenta
Description:
Biosenta Inc., a ground-breaking pioneer in the field of antimicrobial solutions, is on a mission to revolutionize the material world. We develop cutting-edge chemical compounds designed to eliminate harmful microorganisms such as bacteria, fungi, and viruses for household and industrial uses, while ensuring safety for both humans and the environment. Our aim is to address the escalating global health crisis of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).

Our ground-breaking approach has birthed two main offerings:

1.    trueTM Disinfectant: Our pioneering, broad-spectrum, anti-microbial, dual-action disinfectant is recognized by Health Canada for use in the fight against COVID-19. We designed it to be tough on germs but gentle on humans, causing no irritation or harm . With its long-lasting disinfecting power, it effectively kills bacteria, germs, mold, mildew, and viruses. Our trueTM technology leads the charge against the threat of superbug pathogens.

2.    Tri-FillerTM: Biosenta's flagship product, Tri-FillerTM, symbolizes our commitment to transforming the material world. The “Tri” in Tri-FillerTM represents three key characteristics:

i. Antimicrobial Strength: With unparalleled antimicrobial protection, Tri-FillerTM is pivotal against the AMR crisis.

ii. Material Enhancement: A fusion of calcium hydroxide and calcium carbonate, Tri-FillerTM is food-grade and bio-compatible. Besides its antimicrobial nature, it augments the resilience of plastics, paints, textiles, and more. Its durability is tested to last an astounding 99 years.

iii. Eco-Efficiency: Tri-FillerTM integrates CO2 in its process, contributing to reduced emissions and furthering sustainability targets.

Proudly Canadian, Biosenta is at the forefront of reshaping the material world for the better, tackling significant global health and environment challenges. We are committed to making the world a safer and healthier place.

Name: AQLIVIA GLOBAL RESEARCH
Description:
Aqlivia is a global specialty CRO headquartered in Netherlands- India and Middle East, dedicated to serve its clients as a true partner in Pharma drug development, clinical trial.  Aqlivia directly covers more than 20 countries and all key markets in Asia-Pacific, Japan, Europe and N. America, South Korea.
As a premium CRO and being recognized as the quality leader, we focus on the Major therapeutic areas Globally.
Aqlivia provides pre-approval and post-market pharmacovigilance (PV) expertise for pharmaceutical drugs (brand and generic), biologics, radiopharmaceutical drugs, natural health products, medical devices and cosmetics.  Our experienced staff deliver Clinical Research and PV services at all levels including specialist, strategic, and safety physician services.
 
Team is led by Dr Martin, Dr Victor and Mr Jami KK. Complete team bring over 15+ years of combined European, Australian global experience in R&D and medical information and are recognized as expert auditors, trainers and presenters.  

Our professionals can lead or support your Contract Research activities with the required rigor.  Our consulting services include:

•	Pharmacovigilance Self-inspections and Gap Analyses
•	GVP Inspection Preparation and Assistance
•	Pharmacovigilance Training Customized to Meet Your Needs
•	Pharmacovigilance Agreements

•	Foreign Marketing Authorisation Holder and/or Importer GVP Services

•	Risk Management Plans
