•	Individual Case Safety Report Processing
•      Literature (worldwide and local)
•      Medical Information (call centre services)

Name: UBC BIOMOD
Description:
The UBC BIOMOD team consists of talented engineering and science students who have an interest in developing a research career in the natural sciences and engineering. The team plans, designs, and creates a new research project every year under the field of biomolecular nanotechnology to compete against other universities worldwide. Students contribute their own ideas to a research topic, tackling real-life issues they are interested in. Previous projects include developing a more efficient drug delivery mechanism for targeting acute myeloid leukemia and creating an early diagnostic for lung cancer. Students learn useful research development skills, gain method optimization experience, and develop valuable laboratory techniques. 
BIOMOD is an annual undergraduate competition where students from around the world explore new technologies as they build projects ranging from molecular robotics to nanoscale therapeutics using biological macromolecules. The competition motivates students to develop entrepreneurial skills as they build projects from the ground up and secure workspaces, funding, and materials.

Name: BECU TMU
Description: The Biomedical Engineering Course Union (BECU) was formed to support the Biomedical Engineering students at Toronto Metropolitan University (formerly known as Ryerson). Here, we help foster relationships within and outside the community in hopes to give Biomedical Engineering students more resources for their academics, careers, and mental well-being. Overall, BECU strives to create a welcoming and supportive environment for Biomedical Engineering Students as they pursue their degree at TMU

Name: Inspire Biotherapeutics Inc
Description: Inspire has developed a lung tropic AAV gene therapy platform that has demonstrated transduction and long-term expression in lung tissue without impact on other tissue types in disease-relevant animal models. We are currently pursing initiation of a Proof-of-Concept clinical trial for a lethal neonatal lung disease with short time to data readout and success of therapy. The platform can then be applied to Cystic Fibrosis and other monogenic lung diseases.

Name: Moss Genomics
Description: Moss Genomics is a public company (CSE: MOSS; FCE: F73; OTC: MSSGF) developing privacy-focused applications and platforms that empower individuals and healthcare providers with actionable genetic insights while maintaining full ownership and control over sensitive DNA data.

Name: LifeScanner
Description:
We live in a biologically diverse world that we do not always recognize, but it is still there, affecting our lives and impacted by our actions. LifeScanner is an app for iPhone and iPad devices combined with a DNA identification kit to help people discover the diversity of living organisms around them and to help them contribute to a global knowledge-base on biological diversity. Use the app to learn about the species you encounter - from the food you eat to the bugs in your garden.

By providing access to scientific data and processes in an easy-to-use platform, LifeScanner allows non-scientists to explore and access information on species to educate or help make informed decisions. While enjoying the backyard, hiking on a trail, or a day at the beach, users can look up the species found in their region and in other parts of the world or identify species they encounter based on a DNA sample.

Name: ADVIN
Description: Working with multiple stakeholders, ADVIN builds comprehensive healthcare solutions for hard-to-reach communities. Using cutting-edge digital health technology ADVIN allows healthcare workers to monitor patient vital signs, screen for major communicable and non-communicable diseases, and communicate with physicians anywhere in real-time. ADVIN removes the largest barrier to Telehealth adoption by bringing current and measurable health data from biosensors, individual observation, and medical history, together under one platform. Through a strong focus on preventative healthcare, ADVIN is able to provide earlier diagnoses, reduce hospitalization, and decrease healthcare costs.

Name: Quantum Genetix
Description:
Quantum Genetix is an agricultural technology company that harnesses the power of genomics to improve agriculture efficiency. To make this technology accessible and understood by all levels of the agriculture production chain, we employ digital technology to simplify the utility of genomic information.
Quantum Genetix does this through using DNA testing and screening methods to provide farmers and ranchers with insights on their operations that allow them to make better selection and management decisions whilst improving overall sustainability of the industry.  
We identify; Beef and Dairy animals that will have superior performance. /  Disease detection in crops and soils. / Antimicrobial resistance and pathogen quantification. / Food traceability. / Individual beef animal growth rate and endpoint selection program.

Name: Avamab Pharma
Description: Our gene therapy platform, AAV-mAb, is designed to make and release proprietary, specific monoclonal antibodies (mAb) against healthcare-acquired and pandemic infections.

Name: Innovative Regulatory Inc.
Description:
We provide unparalleled regulatory scientific and strategic approaches to help our clients succeed in engaging with health authorities for clinical trial start-up and global market product approvals. 
We also offer specialized services in Animal Rule and Medical Countermeasure development.

Name: Bright Angel Therapeutics
Description: Bright Angel Therapeutics is a Toronto based company focused on tackling the problem of resistance to current antifungal therapies via the development of new drugs that can prevent or revert the emergence of resistance.

Name: Kairos Therapeutics
Description: Kairos Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company with a proprietary next-generation antibody-drug conjugate platform based on novel toxin, linker, and site-specific conjugation technology. This technology enables the development of highly efficacious and targeted therapeutics with reduced side-effects. Through key partnerships, Kairos is developing a pipeline of novel antibody-drug conjugate therapeutics for the treatment of multiple forms of cancer.

Name: Currier Clinical Consulting
Description:
We are currently partnered with 31 of the top 40 CROs in the world who have operations within North America. We have guided Biotech companies through their CRO selection process for their upcoming clinical trials. We can sit on either side of the clinical development table.

We are early-phase and FIH oncology specialists. We guide pre-clinical and clinical stage biotechnology companies through their entry into the clinic, reducing errors and total cash burn, and ensuring the choices of the best-fit CRO and vendors for their outsourcing needs. 

We guide Clinical Research Organizations and vendors to develop better and more strategic client proposals, messaging, and solutions during the pre-award stage to maximize contracted new gross revenue with their biotech leads in the early-phase and FIH oncology space.

Dr. Nathan Currier, the CEO and Founder of Currier Clinical Consulting, possesses over 28 years of experience in the clinical development, pre-clinical development, clinical research, and biotechnology sectors, including 10 years as a subject matter expert (SME) in the clinical research organization (CRO) industry. His PhD is in cellular and molecular biology from McGill University and he has spent the last 28 years entirely focused on oncology and clinical research.

Name: Pinnacle Biotech
Description:
Pinnacle Biotech is an Alberta based grow technology company that is focused on helping cultivation facilities apply technology and grow techniques to successfully grow plants efficiently and cost effectively. Pinnacle's suite of consulting and managed services are tailored to customized indoor growing for food and horticultural production. Recently, Pinnacle has developed a high volume, high density production facility plan leveraging best of breed agricultural practices, the latest grow technology and efficient design while maintaining compliance with Health Canada's licensing specifications for cannabis production and delivering a highly lucrative return on investment. The design can be deployed at any location that has adequate power, water and access to municipal services and a number of Alberta based industrial sites have been shortlisted. All output will be sold to licenced processors in raw form through supply agreements to be processed into derivatives for domestic and global markets. We are at a stage where we are interested in discussing the financing for seed capital investment for facility construction and initial grow cycle operations. For more information , please contact team@pinnaclebiotech.ca. 

Pinnacle BioTech fills a significant gap in the indoor cultivation industries to help entities of all different sizes successfully grow plants. Currently there isn’t a distinct entity in Alberta providing a full suite of consulting and managed services tailored to indoor growing for food and horticultural production. By helping others navigate the complexities of growing we contribute directly to the overall success of the industry and, more importantly, enable people to grow plants and their business.

Pinnacle founders are from the corporate enterprise world of information technology rather than the counterculture element traditionally associated with indoor cultivation.

Name: Core Cryolab Inc.
Description:
Core Cryolab specializes in providing cryogenic services to the medical and scientific communities including storage, shipping, biorepository design, construction, and cryogenic equipment sales.

We provide world-class service to some of Canada’s most prestigious principal investigators, research institutes, clinical studies, and biopharmaceutical communities.

Our experienced staff, redundant security systems, and robust quality system ensure that samples are safely stored and maintained. Core Cryolab’s facilities are located in Toronto General Hospital and near Pearson International Airport in Mississauga.  Both our sites are managed and operated in compliance with regulatory and accreditation bodies.

Core is the only distributor of cryogenic equipment in Canada that is also an end-user. Operating our biorepository and running an international cryogenic shipping business has given our team a superior understanding of the operational needs of our clients. Over the last decade, we have helped design and build numerous biorepositories including some of the largest in Canada.

Core Cryo-Shipping began as a service to storage clients and over the last decade has grown into one of the biggest cryogenic shipping operations in North America. Our global reach in Cryo-Shipping services are utilized by the IVF community and serve as a key component in cold chain management within both the pharmaceutical and medical research industries.

Our mission is to raise the bar in terms of protecting the long-term value of the samples stored in cryogenic facilities throughout Canada and beyond. We work to accomplish this through our comprehensive range of cryogenic related products and services for biorepositories with personalized service from our experienced staff.

Name: Glysantis Biotech Inc.
Description:
Glysantis has developed the world’s first truly druggable TLR-3 agonist. Our patented monodisperse nanoparticle safely delivers immune-activating compounds to tumors. GLY100TM is a first-in-class innate immunomodulatory nanomedicine designed to enable safe, systemic activation of Toll-Like Receptor 3 (TLR-3) in solid tumors, reversing immunosuppression and activating anti-tumor immunity. 

We are building a nano immunotherapy delivery platform for immune evasive cancers. Our initial focus is ovarian cancer, with a long term vision to enhance outcomes across multiple difficult to treat tumors by enhancing existing therapies.

Name: Queen’s BioMechatronics Team (QBMeT)
Description:
The Queen's BioMechatronics Team (QBMeT) seeks to design lower-limb robotic exoskeleton suits to enhance the performance of first responders — firefighters, paramedics, etc. — who carry heavy loads in demanding environments. Our exoskeletons feature lightweight, articulative motors at the hip and knee joints, with an emphasis on streamlined and unobstructed movement.

With three dedicated sub-teams — Structural, Power Systems, and Software — we are committed to developing innovative solutions that are functional, efficient, and tailored to the rigorous needs of those who serve on the front lines.

Name: FluroTech
Description: FluroTech is a technology and marketing company whose core business is focused on the commercialization of new technologies in the cannabis industry. FluroTech’s proprietary spectroscopy-based technology allows for the testing and identification of organic and inorganic compounds contained within biological samples derived from cannabis plants. Using the technology that was developed at the University of Calgary in conjunction with the University of Alberta, FluroTech has developed a two-part solution comprising an instrument called the CompleTestTM and consumable testing kits.

Name: Pioreactor
Description: We build the Pioreactor, a low-cost, easy-to-scale bioreactor. The Pioreactor ideal for teaching biology to children, to graduate students, to scaling up a lab, and everything in between: the Pioreactor is accessible by design.

Name: Nutrienvisus Technologies Inc
Description: Nutrienvisus Technologies, Inc is the innovator of Enviotin and Enviotics, precision formulated organic plant nutrients and plant probiotics with products that provide natural, eco-friendly, and good balance of organic nutrients and beneficial microbes for fertile soil and healthy plant growth. Nutrienvisus will strive to recycle brewery by-products and produce near “zero” waste from its facility, to be one of the most environmentally friendly companies. With their innovative products, Nutrienvisus finds a solution for some of the challenges in agriculture and brewery industries.

Name: Blue Goose Biorefineries Inc
Description:
Blue Goose Biorefineries Inc. is a technology development company primarily focused on converting biomass into cellulose nanocrystals (CNC). 

The BGB method of producing cellulose nanocrystals is based on transition metal catalyzed oxidation of lignocellulosic biomass.  The final product is a non-sulfonated, lightly carboxylated CNC.

Our process is both commercially scalable and cost competitive when compared with other methods for producing CNC. 

In addition to being inherently renewable and sustainable with a limited environmental footprint, CNC has unique and advantageous properties for commercial applications. Potential applications of CNC include: concrete admixtures; rheology modifiers; reinforcement for polymer materials; barrier films; optical films or coatings; biomedicine; CNC foams and aerogels; and CNC continuous fibers.

BGB does not impose any restrictions or encumbrances on the intellectual property (IP) garnered from your research.

Blue Goose Biorefineries: (Overview)

    Wholly owned subsidiary of Nano-Green Biorefineries Inc.
    Operates a pilot plant in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada
    Producing 50 kg/week of CNC
    Offers CNC to interested parties without Intellectual Property restrictions
    Collaborates with parties developing market applications for CNC

Name: Nova Mentis Life Science Corp.
Description:
Nova Mentis Life Science Corp. is a Canadian-based biotechnology company and global leader in developing diagnostics and psilocybin-based therapeutics for neuroinflammatory disorders.

We are the first biotech company to achieve psilocybin orphan drug designation in both the United States and European Union.

The goal is to diagnose and treat debilitating chronic conditions that have unmet medical needs, such as autism spectrum disorder and fragile X syndrome.

CSE: NOVA  |  OTCQB: NMLSF  |  FSE: HN3Q

Name: Perturba Therapeutics
Description: Perturba integrates Cyclica’s AI-augmented drug discovery platform with sensitive, live-cell drug screening assays from the Stagljar lab.

Name: Genepika
Description:
Genepika is a biotechnology company building platform technologies for human lifespan extension.

Our long-term mission is to preserve, restore, and extend human biological function. We believe meaningful progress in life extension will require more than a single therapeutic product. It will require integrated technology platforms that can rejuvenate aged tissues, measure biological state continuously, model human physiology with AI, and preserve biological function across time.

Our work begins with cellular rejuvenation, with an initial focus on human skeletal muscle. Skeletal muscle is central to strength, mobility, metabolic health, recovery, and long-term independence, making it a crucial first target for restoring age-linked functional decline. We are developing transcription factor-based rejuvenation strategies supported by human tissue models, AI-guided analysis, and advanced automation systems.

In parallel, we are building toward continuous health monitoring as core infrastructure for lifespan extension. Longitudinal biological data can help detect meaningful change earlier, establish personalized baselines, and guide more precise intervention strategies over time.

Together, these directions support our broader vision of extending functional human lifespan and enabling a future where human health, resilience, and biological performance can be maintained for life beyond earth.

Name: SmallMolecules.com
Description: SmallMolecules.com is an online product listing service dedicated exclusively to small molecule products for biomedical research.   Researchers can search and source small molecule products from manufacturers around the world.  It is the first and only scientific website dedicated to this important product range.

Name: GreenSage Prebiotics
Description: We focus on the development and application of prebiotics from coconut for aquaculture and for human health.
Location: Nova Scotia And Ontario, Nova Scotia, Canada

Name: Biomedical Engineering Society - Toronto Metropolitan University Chapter (BMES TMU)
Description:
We are Toronto Metropolitan University's student branch of the Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES TMU). 

BMES TMU's  workshops and events aim to improve the professional competence of all interested students in the biotechnology sector.

Name: NATUR+L XTD inc.
Description: L'entreprise se spécialise dans les services d'impartition pour les produits alimentaires bénéficiants de l'application de la technologie à très haute pression hydrostatique (HPP). Cette technologie permet de détruire NATURELLEMENT les pathogènes de type Listeria, Salmonella, E. Coli.; elle prend aussi en charge les moisissures, levures et les phénomènes d'oxydation. La durée des aliments est allongée d'au moins 2 fois, voire jusqu'à 10 fois tout en diminuant/éliminant les agents de conservation et le sodium. Cette technologie permet de développer des produits actuellement impossible à commercialiser avec les méthodes utilisées couramment.

Name: Nemrod Biotechnology
Description:
Did you know that besides containing the blue-print to most life forms, nucleic acids are molecules that are able to adopt complex 3D structures? These structures give them the ability to bind strongly to a wide array of targets in a selective manner. Nucleic acids structures with such binding abilities are called aptamers.
Besides target recognition and binding, there is a specific class of these nucleic acids that are able to simultaenously bend or cleave DNA and RNA (aptazymes), which then allows for allosteric gene expression and regulation (riboswitches).
Our platform allows an efficient high-throughput production of these powerful molecular tools in a customized manner, in order to provide our clients the tools needed to detect their target of choice, and, if desired, alter their sequence or gene of interest.

Name: Bioada
Description:
At Bioada, we redefine the future of healthcare by empowering early disease detection and personalized treatments. Our AI-powered multi-omics platform is the only solution in the world that seamlessly integrates all types of omics data, solving the biomarker reproducibility challenge and unlocking new possibilities in biomarker and therapeutic discovery.

From identifying life-changing diagnostic biomarkers to targeting novel therapeutic drivers, Bioada’s proprietary Genomarker platform and cutting-edge research methodologies set a new standard in accuracy, speed, and reliability. Our robust pipeline addresses diverse disease areas, including oncology, neurology, and rare diseases, with diagnostics achieving unprecedented precision and therapeutics aimed at uncovering new frontiers in treatment.

Driven by our mission to put patients first, we bridge the gap between cutting-edge science and compassionate care, transforming innovation into real-world solutions.

Name: Club for Undergraduate Biomedical Engineering
Description: CUBE (Club for Undergraduate Biomedical Engineering) is a student-run club whose mandate is to promote biomedical engineering at the undergraduate level. The oldest and largest chapter was founded in 1997 by Mark Ebden and Ran Gilad at the University of Toronto. Currently, the Toronto chapter has over 600 members from different programs and faculties. To disseminate knowledge pertaining to the biomedical field as well as to serve as a point of contact between students, researchers and industry. This is accomplished by hosting events such as information sessions on the latest cutting-edge research in the fields of biomedical engineering, medicine and biotechnology; attending international conferences in related areas; networking with industry leaders during held speaker seminars; and touring various industrial plants, hospitals and laboratories.

Name: Beagle Scientific Inc.
Description:
Beagle is a biotech research and consulting company with a mission to support your scientific innovation through customized services. 

Visit us at www.beaglesci.com

Name: Dx BioTech Inc.
Description:
Dx BioTech's mission is to democratize cytometry by developing and commercializing a new class of simpler analytical instruments for life science researchers and clinical diagnostics professionals. Bringing greater autonomy, testing agility and efficiency to researchers, drug developers, doctors and patients. This simplification will in turn result in a progressive decentralized use of cytometry.

Recent technology evolutions have enabled the miniaturization of flow cytometers. The new breed of smaller flow cytometers made “personal cytometry” possible. However, these new cytometers are built with the same laser and free-space optical architecture, making them hardly portable and equally sensitive to vibrations.

Dx BioTech aims to commercialize an innovative technology platform that integrates fiber optics, provides the ruggedness and portability that was missing in this practice, and opens an array of new possibilities in flow cytometry.

Our use of FiberFlowFluidics results in micro- sheath, ultra-compact, lightweight instruments, designed for daily use for the majority of common flow cytometry applications. The simplified and cost-effective HPC instruments are rugged and vibration-proof, and can be easily transported for use under a hood, in a glove box, in another laboratory, or for fieldwork. This new platform is a step forward in simplifying and democratizing the use of cytometry.

Name: RocketBio
Description:
At RocketBio, we invest exclusively in tissue engineering and biotools companies for the long-term, working side-by-side to unlock sustainable growth and transformative breakthroughs.

Because we aim to hold our investments, we make every decision with a long-term view in mind.

Name: ClotGuard
Description: ClotGuard is a wearable patch that automatically detects bleeding and delivers nanobots carrying platelets directly to the injury site. Using embedded sensors for biomarkers like thrombin and oxygen, it ensures targeted, rapid response to blood loss. The system stores freeze-dried platelets and employs biodegradable nanobots for safe deactivation, combining real-time monitoring with precision treatment to prevent excessive bleeding.

Name: innonet Inc.
Description: Innonet Inc. is the pioneer of a fully Organic Active Agent of Chitosan and Herbal Oils Complex, with a wide range of applications in medical, health, and sanitary products, such as organic disinfectant and hand sanitizer; self-sanitizing PPE, and antimicrobial plastics, and textiles.

Name: NanoLumina Technologies
Description:
NanoLumina Technologies is a next-generation biotech startup advancing light-responsive nanomedicine for precision oncology. We harness the power of light at the nanoscale to develop smart, targeted photothermal and photoimmunotherapy systems for cancer treatment. Our platform is rooted in cutting-edge translational research and driven by a mission to make cancer therapies safer, smarter, and more effective.

From the lab bench to clinical potential, NanoLumina is committed to illuminating new frontiers in cancer care—where innovation meets impact.

 https://nanoluminatech.com

 Canada | India (Remote Operations)

Name: Attest Laboratories
Description: Our mission is to develop a portable, accurate, and convenient to use instrument for point-of-care testing of metabolite biomarkers.  We are designing the instrument to be capable of non-invasive measurement of metabolite concentrations by scanning a finger.  Powered by advances in Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (MRS), the instrument has universal detection capabilities that make it a compelling platform for improving clinical research, screening/diagnosis, and management of diabetes and other metabolic conditions.

Name: PharmaPlanter Technologies
Description:
With state of the art wet lab and animal facility in Vancouver, British Columbia, PharmaPlanter Technologies Inc. provides one-stop biomodeling solution and CRO services under the brand of Therapeutic Modeling & Experimentation (TME).

We turn our expertise in mouse and cell line modeling into an efficient and cost-effective technology platform and provide contract research services, mainly focusing on preclinical studies and IND-enabling services, to assist biotech companies to develop their therapeutic solutions and to support life science researchers to translate their scientific work into future therapies, aiming to overcome critical health challenges.

Our areas of expertise include - 
•	Gene engineering animal and cell models
•	Monoclonal antibody development
•	Animal experimentation
•	Culture media

To learn more details, please visit TME website https://www.tme-scientific.com

Name: Fixed Earth Innovations
Description:
Fixed Earth provides custom microbial solutions to impossible problems in environmental restoration and remediation, tailoring its technologies based on client needs. Fixed Earth enables ecological restoration by working with clients to obtain and encapsulate native seed for use in commercial and industrial reclamation projects. Fixed Earth is also able to provide microbial amendments to support the germination and development of plants on reclamation/restoration projects.

By partnering with mother nature, Fixed Earth has unlocked nondisruptive and cost-effective techniques to complete in-situ soil and water remediation of difficult pollutants.

Learn more by visiting: fixed.earth
Location: Fort St John, British Columbia, Canada

Name: Lafayette Life Science
Description:
Comprised of Lafayette Instrument, Campden Instruments, Aurora Scientific, Actimetrics, and ALZET LLC, Lafayette Life Science provides instrumentation, distribution, and support to research institutions, universities, and laboratories around the world.

Lafayette Instrument
From Activity Monitoring Systems, Operant Test Chambers, to Motility Testing Solutions, Lafayette Instrument offers an extensive range of products for behavioral neuroscience studies. Products designed to support researchers with conditioning, learning, activity monitoring, cognitive evaluation, and sleep deprivation studies.

Gelatin is obtained by the hydrolysis of collagen which is the principal protein found in skin and 
bones. Fish gelatin is being extracted commercially in Nova Scotia by Kenney & Ross at Port Saxon.
The raw material is the skin from deep water fish such as cod, haddock and pollock, and is obtained 
from local salt fish and frozen skins. The uniqueness of cold water fish gelatin lies in the amino acid 
composition of the gelatin. Although all gelatins are composed of the same 20 amino acids, there can be 
a variation in the amount of amino acids, proline and hydroxyproline. With lower amounts of these 
amino acids, there is less hydrogen bonding of gelatin in water solutions, and hence a reduction in 
the gelling temperature. Gelatin from cod skin gels at 5-10oC, whereas gelatin from carp skin would be 
more similar to animal gelatin, which gels above room temperature. Most people think of gelatin as a 
food additive or part of photographic film. With a lower gelling temperature, other commercial 
applications of cold water fish gelatin have been developed.

Name: Spectral Medical Inc.
Description:
Spectral Medical is a Phase 3 company advancing the fight against endotoxic septic shock through an innovative theranostic approach. This unique strategy combines the EAATM Endotoxin Activity Assay, the only FDA-cleared diagnostic for the risk of developing sepsis, with targeted rapid therapy using ToraymyxinTM (PMX). PMX is a Polymyxin B extracorporeal direct hemoadsorption column which is highly effective in removing endotoxin in the bloodstream.

Already approved in Japan and Europe (1994 and 2002 respectively), PMX has been safely used on over 340,000 patients. Spectral holds exclusive U.S. development and commercialization rights for PMX since 2009, with a distribution agreement for Canada since 2010. 

In July 2022, the FDA granted Breakthrough Device Designation to PMX for treating endotoxic septic shock, a condition that affects around 330,000 people in North America annually.

Spectral is currently conducting the Tigris Trial, a confirmatory study evaluating PMX combined with standard care vs. standard care alone in a 2:1 randomized trial of 150 patients, utilizing Bayesian statistics to assess its effectiveness. The trial methods are detailed in the Critical Care publication  “Bayesian methods: a potential path forward for sepsis trials." https://doi.org/10.1186/s13054-023-04717-x

Name: Chinova Bioworks
Description:
Chinova Bioworks is a biotechnology company specializing in natural preservation solutions for the food and beverage industries. Our clean-label ingredients are designed to improve shelf life, reduce spoilage, and meet growing consumer demand for transparency—without the use of synthetic preservatives.

At the core of our innovation is ChiberTM, a natural fibre extracted from white button mushrooms. This broad-spectrum antimicrobial is effective across a range of applications, including plant-based dairy, functional beverages, sauces, dressings, dips, baked goods and more. ChiberTM is easy to integrate, taste-neutral, and supports cleaner ingredient labels.

Rooted in circular economy principles, our process upcycles mushroom waste into high-performance ingredients—delivering both functional and sustainable value. With growing adoption across North America, Europe, and Asia, Chinova is scaling globally to support manufacturers seeking next-generation preservation technologies that align with regulatory and consumer expectations.

Our work has been featured in Forbes, TechCrunch, Food Navigator, and more, and has been recognised for pushing the boundaries of natural ingredient innovation. As a woman-founded, Atlantic Canada-based company, we bring scientific rigour, formulation expertise, and sustainable thinking to every partnership.

At Chinova Bioworks, we’re not just extending shelf life—we’re helping reshape the future of clean-label product development, one product at a time.

Name: Renaissance BioScience Corp.
Description:
Renaissance BioScience is an environmental impact company whose bioengineering platform technologies develop innovative, market-ready, functional microorganisms that provide solutions to a broad range of health and environmental problems. Based in Vancouver, Canada, Renaissance is currently developing technologies for the oral delivery of RNA, targeting human and animal health, biopesticides and aquaculture solutions.

RNAi and mRNA are valuable and revolutionary technology that has been widely applied in medicine and agriculture facilitating sustainable practices and technologies that combine effectiveness with a minimal environmental footprint.

Description:

Name: Bind Research
Description: Many incurable diseases (e.g., cancer, neurodegeneration) involve biomolecules called ‘disordered proteins’. Considered ‘undruggable’ by the mainstream pharmaceutical industry, disordered proteins continuously change their three-dimensional shapes and lack long-lived sites with which drug-molecules can interact. Our mission is to make disordered proteins druggable. We will screen millions of disordered protein/drug-molecule pairs to learn the rules of drugging disordered proteins. Building on our expertise and working with academic and industrial partners, we will leverage cutting-edge biology, engineering, and AI to deliver new drugs and tools. To accomplish this in a manner for maximum societal benefit, we have established a Focused Research Organisation (FRO), a fully-independent not-for-profit entity dedicated to this goal.

Description:

MagnetodronesTM are unique medication-bearing bacteria, developed by StarpaxTM, that are sensitive to magnetic fields. At the same time, the MagnetodronesTM saturate hypoxic areas where cancerous cells are difficult to reach with other treatments. Magnetodrones are injected directly into the tumour and are guided by the PolarTrak device, in which the patient is positioned. The PolarTrakTM prevents the MagnetodronesTM from leaving the tumour and guides them in 3D with special magnetic fields.

Name: Imeka

Human-Relevant Platforms for Predictive Discovery.

Bioauxilium is a private Canadian biotechnology company founded by seasoned scientists from PerkinElmer (now Revvity). Name: QIAGEN
Description:
Making improvements in life possible is more than our vision. It is the reason QIAGEN exists.
 
From combating cancer and diagnosing infectious diseases to keeping food and communities safe, the world's most urgent challenges begin with unlocking the insights hidden in DNA and RNA, the building blocks of life. That is where we come in.
 
We are QIAGEN, a Netherlands-based global leader in Sample to Insight solutions. Our technologies isolate and process DNA, RNA and proteins, prepare them for analysis, and turn complex molecular data into clear, actionable insights. Automation brings it together into seamless workflows for the Life Sciences (academia, pharmaceutical R&D and industrial applications such as forensics) and Molecular Diagnostics for clinical healthcare.
 
Every day, more than 500,000 customers around the world rely on us to extract meaning from genetic material quickly, confidently and accurately, from young scientists and pharma R&D teams to clinical labs and more than 35 Nobel Prize winners.
 
Behind it all are the QIAGENers, more than 5,000 colleagues across 75 nationalities and subsidiaries in 25 countries, united by the three promises in our name: Quality, Ingenuity and Accessibility.

STEMCELL Technologies is a Canadian biotechnology company that helps power leading-edge life science research around the world. Driven by our love of science and passion for quality, we are Scientists Helping Scientists—standing by our customers to provide the outstanding products, technical support, and training they need to advance their research. Scientists performing stem cell, immunology, cancer, regenerative medicine, and cellular therapy research are among those who rely on our cell culture media, cell separation products, instruments, accessory products, and services. 

Since the launch of the company by Dr. Allen Eaves in 1993, STEMCELL has reinvested all profits back into the research and development of products to better support the international research community. Today, STEMCELL is the largest biotech company in Canada, with over 2000 employees globally, most with scientific or engineering degrees. Through our many regional offices, as well as our distribution centers in Vancouver, Seattle, Grenoble, and Singapore, we deliver our innovative, specialized products to more than 70 countries. 

At STEMCELL, we are dedicated to improving lives through advancing knowledge and scientific discovery, through our commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion in STEM and the life sciences industry, and through our investments in sustainability, community, and social responsibility. We have a strong track record, having advanced multiple vaccines from early R&D to approvals, and currently market three proprietary travel vaccines, including the world’s first and only chikungunya vaccine, as well as certain third-party vaccines.

CellCarta offers access to integrated analytical platforms in immunology (immune monitoring), histopathology, proteomics and genomics, as well as digital pathology/AI and sample management, logistics and kitting services.

At CellCarta we are experts at assessing the immune system, whether in the context of oncology, infectious diseases, or autoimmune diseases. Name: Yourgene Health
Description:
Yourgene Health offers a comprehensive suite of non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) solutions, including a complete NGS workflow designed to provide laboratories with flexible, scalable testing and a broad clinical menu, tailored to their needs. In addition, Yourgene provide a clinical NIPT sample service through the Manchester Genomic Service Laboratory for healthcare professionals. 

Supporting the wider reproductive lifecycle, Yourgene offer a portfolio of PCR-based clinical screening assays, including tests for cystic fibrosis, aneuploidy analysis, pregnancy loss, male factor infertility, and thrombosis risk. 

As part of the expanding Precision Medicine portfolio, the Yourgene DPYD genotyping PCR assay supports safer chemotherapy regimes, by identifying patients at risk of severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity. Early detection of DPD deficiency before starting 5-FU treatment enables clinicians to adjust chemotherapy dosing and avoid serious, potentially life-threatening adverse reactions. 

Powered by Ranger Technology, Yourgene’s portfolio of automated DNA size selection instruments delivers high-precision fragment selection and dynamic target enrichment across a wide range of clinical and research sequencing applications. Designed to support laboratories from low- to high-throughput workflows, Ranger instruments provide an innovative solution for applications including NIPT, gene synthesis, CRISPR gene editing, and long-read sequencing.  

The LightBench Discover is an automated 3-in-1 electrophoresis system combining DNA size selection, fragment length analytics, and quantification in a single benchtop solution, removing the need for multiple instruments and simplifying laboratory workflows. 

Yourgene Health is headquartered in Manchester, UK with facilities in Singapore, the US and Canada. Yourgene is part of the Novacyt group of companies.

Visit yourgenehealth.com for further information, or contact info@yourgenehealth.com

Description:

On this common architecture, we build, run and improve the world’s best Biological Foundation Models in an effort to transform the field of drug discovery - finding molecules and targets others would miss, and accelerating their development into life changing medicines for patients.

Name: CCRM
Description:
Regenerative Medicine (RM), which aims to harness the power of stem cells, biomaterials and molecules to repair, regenerate or replace diseased cells, tissues and organs, has the promise to treat, manage and perhaps cure some of the most devastating and costly diseases in the world today.

Many new and potentially life-changing RM-based treatments never reach patients because they are not successfully moved from the laboratory to a stage where they can be used in medicine. In order to fulfill RM’s promise to treat the many diseases affecting our population, a world-renowned group of stem cell scientists and engineers have come together to form CCRM, a leader in developing and commercializing regenerative medicine and cell therapy technologies. CCRM formally launched on June 14, 2011.

CCRM supports the development and commercialization of regenerative medicines and associated enabling technologies, with a specific focus on cell and gene therapy.

The people of Seegene are on a purposeful mission to improve the world we live in. We aim to improve the quality of life for everyone globally by bringing molecular diagnostics to the masses.

Molecular diagnostics is the most effective method to accurately diagnose ailments and is also the best way to diagnose them early which is when you can make the most difference in the recovery treatment.

Testament to our expertise, when the pandemic started, Seegene was one of the first companies in the world to provide testing kits that were crucial in the fight against COVID.

In keeping with our spirit of innovation and making a difference in the world, there are many exciting innovations being worked on at Seegene which will make it easier for the world to access the benefits of molecular diagnostics.
